question: Which of the following Indian musicians was called ‘Mallika-e-Ghazal’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Begum Akhtar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Begum Akhtar** was a renowned Indian singer, often referred to as '**Mallika-e-Ghazal**' which translates to 'Queen of Ghazals'.
